## Authors & Contributors

```{r}
#| results: asis

author_str <- sapply(metadata$author, function(x) {
    if ("@id" %in% names(x)) {
        orcidstr <- sprintf("(ORCID: <%s>) — ", x[["@id"]])
    } else {
        orcidstr <- " — "
    }
    affstr <- paste(sapply(x[["affiliation"]], function(y) {
        y[["name"]]
    }), collapse = "; ")
    sprintf("- **%s %s**%s%s\n", x[["givenName"]], x[["familyName"]], orcidstr, affstr)
})

cat(author_str)
```

**Author Contributions:** MGT led the expert elicitation process. MGT and DAK contributed membership tables for cross-referencing. JRFP led the technical documentation and synthesis workflow. JRFP, EG, and ARS contributed scripts for data preparation, validation, analysis, and spatial output generation.
